conclusion: Identical failure at the earliest possible moment: the sleep request crashes the firmware in a session that has only booted (no NVMMU setup, no queues, no controller enable). Everything after the boot handshake is eliminated. Every failing sleep was against a Linux-booted session; every successful one against an m1n1-booted session. Next step is a desk audit of the boot paths at register level (SART, mailbox control, endpoint buffers, IOP carveout, PMGR/clock state), which the message-level comparison cannot see.
